item.title: BART approves 'worst-case scenario' budget plan if it doesn't secure additional funding
item.description: What would happen if the BART didn't secure additional funding? The potential fix is closing up to 15 stations, reducing train service and laying off 1,200 employees.

item.title: Worker swept away in Sierra foothills pipeline rupture recovering from broken bones, collapsed lung
item.description: Weeks after a pipeline burst sent water rushing through the Sierra foothills, a security guard who was swept into the Yuba River and rescued by helicopter is recovering from multiple broken bones and a collapsed lung, his wife says.

item.title: Group in car attacked in San Francisco by dozens of bicycle riders in violent 'ride out'
item.description: Isaac Auerbach says dozens of teens on bicycles surrounded his car after he and friends were leaving the Red Bull event in the Marina District Saturday. The car had broken glass, visible damage and even a shoeprint left behind.

item.title: 20-year-old plaintiff testifies she became addicted to social media as early as 6 in landmark trial
item.description: The woman - identified in court as KGM - is the key plaintiff in the case, which alleges she began using social media as young as age 6 and became dependent on the apps.

item.title: Friends rescue man buried in snow while skiing at Palisades Tahoe, video shows
item.description: We're learning more about an incredible rescue that was caught on camera at Palisades Tahoe. Two skiers are credited with saving a man's life after they found him buried in deep snow last week. Their story serves as a reminder for skiers and snowboarders to be prepared.

item.title: San Jose teen accused of 3D printing 27 ghost guns in bedroom, DA says
item.description: An 18-year-old San Jose man is accused of manufacturing 27 ghost guns in his bedroom, including some modified to function like machine guns, prosecutors said.

item.title: Instagram says it will notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide
item.description: Instagram said Thursday it will start alerting parents if their kids repeatedly search for terms clearly associated with suicide or self-harm.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery deems Paramount's takeover bid superior to Netflix deal
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery's studio and streaming business.

item.title: No clear front-runner in race for California governor, new poll shows
item.description: A new poll shows there's still no clear front-runner in the race to replace Gov. Gavin Newsom.

item.title: 'Dripping in gold:' Meet the designer behind Alysa Liu's dress now part of Olympic history
item.description: After more than 100 hours of designing, sewing and hand-placed beading, a piece of gold fabric transformed into an iconic gold-medal look for Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu.
